Re-format Numeric Cells in FSsg_tab at a Lower Precision

Source: R/summarize_bootstrap_results.R
dot-reformat_FSsg_tab_digits.Rd

Parses formatted-string cells in FSsg_tab back to numerics and re-formats at the requested digits. Designed for display-time precision control in summarize_bootstrap_results.

Usage

.reformat_FSsg_tab_digits(tab, digits)

Arguments

tab

Data frame or matrix with formatted-string cells.

digits

Integer. Decimal places.

Value

Reformatted tab, same shape.

Details

Cells are identified by column name pattern, not content sniffing. Three cell formats are recognized:

  1. Single value with optional sign and percent suffix (Mean(C)/(T), Rate(C)/(T), Diff): "-56.4321", "+12.5", "42.1%".

  2. Three-value CI (effect-measure column, "\{measure\} (95% CI)"): "82.7831 (14.8067, 150.7585)".

  3. Three-value CI without space (bias-corrected "\{measure\}*" column): "72.4500 (-61.5400,206.4400)".

Columns NOT touched: Subgroup (text label), n and n1 (count-with-percent format like "87 (8.0%)" — different semantics).

Robustness contract: cells that don't match any expected pattern are returned unchanged. Construction-time precision must be at least digits for the reformat to be informative; if construction was at lower precision, this function will zero-pad to digits but cannot recover information.
